Reconcile a real complete export in disposable nonfixture storage, preserving IDs, semantics, dependencies and gates; archive/hash original history and evidence with resolvable provenance. Keep imported manual completion labels honest.

Rehearse real Beamfall gates, capacity serialization, lease expiry, stale generation, disjoint/overlapping claims, crash cleanup and integration. No printf stand-ins establish production qualification.
Move agents, bf tools, review/finish helpers, hooks and active reports to Tasks or a read-only projection. Verify every retired writer refuses after the authority fence.

Demonstrate recovery after native create/update/completion, retaining all post-cutover writes. Obtain final approval of a concrete frozen export, drain/fence state, migration diff and recovery procedure before activation.
After activation, retain an actual native completed ticket, readback and receipt audit; keep this ticket OPEN until that production evidence exists.
body:
